    • waitForExportCompletion

      public Export waitForExportCompletion(Export export) throws ChargebeeException, InterruptedException
      Waits for an export operation to complete by polling its status. Polls every 10 seconds (configurable via cb.java.export.sleep.millis system property).
      Parameters:
      export - The export to wait for (must have a valid ID)
      Returns:
      The completed Export object with COMPLETED or FAILED status
      Throws:
      ChargebeeException - if API call fails during polling
      RuntimeException - if export takes too long (over 50 polling attempts)
      InterruptedException - if thread is interrupted while waiting
